Sightseeing in the United Kingdom

游览英国 · 191 词 · 2 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1After the wedding, my cousin and his wife went sightseeing around the United Kingdom. He faxed a letter to me in English yesterday. To my delight, he no longer made any errors in verb tense. His description clarified some of my questions about the UK’s currency, its administration, its four constituent countries and the conflicts surrounding the separation of what is now the Republic of Ireland from the UK.

2Unwilling to leave out any attraction, my cousin arranged his enjoyable journey carefully. One attractive place he visited was a castle near a port in the Scottish countryside. It used to be the headquarters of a communist union, but it was damaged during the war. People thought nothing could replace its splendid architecture, and they finished rebuilding it in 1952. It was to their credit that the rooms had been furnished in a style consistent with the original. My cousin was thrilled by its collections, which consisted of statues and royal uniforms folded inside glass display cases. Though there was no possibility to buy some of these exhibits, it was convenient to take photos, which he sent me along with his fax.

游览英国

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1婚礼结束后，我表哥和他的妻子去了英国，到各地观光。昨天，他传真给我一封英文信。让我高兴的是，他已经不再用错时态了。他的描述解答了我对英国的一些疑问，包括它的货币、行政体系和四个组成国，以及如今的爱尔兰共和国脱离英国时发生的冲突。

2表哥不想漏掉任何一个景点，便仔细安排了这趟愉快的旅行。他去的一个好地方是苏格兰乡间的一座城堡，附近有个港口。城堡曾是一个共产主义联盟的总部，后来在战争中损毁。人们觉得这座宏伟的建筑无可替代，于是在 1952 年完成了重建。值得称赞的是，各个房间的陈设都和过去一样。表哥看到收藏的雕像，以及叠好摆在玻璃柜里的王室制服，兴奋极了。有些展品买不到，拍照却很方便，他便随传真一并把照片发给了我。
